decision_rule.ADMITTED: the CI95 lower bound of the paired official pooled SLU-F1 delta (CELL-3 minus the sealed DEV-2000-ADDED PLAN arm) is ABOVE ZERO, and the CI95 lower bound of the paired intent delta exceeds -h_intent, the roster's own-null intent half-width. A gain is proven, not merely non-inferior.
decision_rule.FRONTIER: owner decision 75: the frontier row (official SLU-F1 delta x prefilled tokens per row x GPU hours per 1,000 rows) is reported on every verdict and placed beside the registered rows. Note the denominator is 1,000 rows here, not 1,080: a TRAIN Fold A frontier row is not comparable digit for digit and is rescaled or labelled, never silently placed beside.
decision_rule.GATE_CONSUMPTION: PRIMARY DELIVERABLE, reported whatever the verdict: the gated-row share per node from the delta-consumption read -- how many rows each candidate-bound node had its supply WITHHELD on (delta_supply skip, reason scenario-gate-closed) against how many it was supplied on, the open/closed counts the delta_scenario_gate receipt publishes, and the realised majority-scenario histogram. The model-free PROJECTION from the sealed comparator's own Perception candidates is 355 closed / 645 open of 1,000 rows on every gated node; the realised number is measured, never assumed, because the arm's own Perception answers are its own (greedy decoding is not bit-reproducible across batch compositions). A realised share far from 355 is a finding, not a failure.
decision_rule.HARMFUL: a MEASURED loss on either guard (owner decision 25, Method B: a CI95 upper bound below zero, or a point estimate beyond the margin); width alone is NEUTRAL, never HARMFUL.
decision_rule.NEUTRAL: both guards are non-inferior at the roster's own null -- the SLU CI95 lower bound exceeds -h_SLU and the intent CI95 lower bound exceeds -h_intent -- without a proven SLU gain.
decision_rule.OUT_OF_FOLD: THE VENUE IS THE POINT AND IT CUTS BOTH WAYS. The seven gated scenarios were chosen on TRAIN Fold A, from the CELL-2 read and the general-scenario diagnostic; DEV-2000-ADDED is a roster the Stage-3 delta line has never touched, so this is the FIRST out-of-fold read of that line and the first time the gated set is exposed to selection it did not shape. It is still a DEVELOPMENT number (owner decisions 28, 86): DEV-2000-ADDED is a development roster, and no test, superiority, generalisation or paper-scale claim is read from this cell.
decision_rule.PER_STRATUM: owner decision 17 asks for a per-scenario table in both weightings. On this roster a GOLD per-scenario table is NOT DERIVABLE model-free: the roster receipt withholds the per-item stratum (stratum_withheld_per_item: true) and the official per-sample record carries no scenario field, so deriving one needs gold, which is refused (cell B6's own read records this and the open registration item). What IS reported, in both the natural-mixture and the equal-stratum weighting, is the table over the strata the MECHANISM acts on: the row's PREDICTED majority candidate scenario, which is exactly what the gate reads and is model-free by construction. Gate-closed versus gate-open is reported as its own two-cell stratification. The absence of the gold table is stated in the verdict, never omitted.
decision_rule.REPLICATION: an ADMITTED result is replicated on the SAME roster before any Fold B or test read (the owner iteration rule). No test read is authorised by this package (owner decision 29: one test read, after Stage 3).
decision_rule.TWIN: ATTRIBUTION, never admission. The twin arm is read with the same estimator against the same sealed DEV-2000-ADDED PLAN comparator, and it carries THE SAME GATE. A gain the twin reproduces within the roster's own null is FORM (the gated supply's shape and token volume on the rows the gate leaves open), not content, and the verdict says so and claims no content effect. A gain the twin does not reproduce is attributed to the deltas' content, with the twin delta reported beside it.
decision_rule.comparator: the sealed DEV-2000-ADDED PLAN arm SAEA-SLURP-NATIVE-DEFAULT-PLAN-DEV2000-ADDED-V1 (official 65.40 SLU / 76.6 intent, flight commit 54f569c6); nothing is re-flown
decision_rule.efficiency_is_reported_regardless: every efficiency deliverable is reported whatever the verdict
decision_rule.margins: THE MARGINS ARE NOT KNOWN AT REGISTRATION AND ARE NOT TYPED HERE. h_SLU and h_intent for this cell are the half-widths the ROSTER'S OWN NULL produces -- cell PLAN-DEV2000 against cell PLANr-DEV2000 (SAEA-SLURP-NATIVE-DEFAULT-PLAN-DEV2000-ADDED-REPLICATE-V1), the request-identical second pass registered in this same package and flown FIRST -- computed with the same paired estimator, the same clustering (utterance id, owner decision 79 D2), the same seed and the same draws as the arm contrast. The TRAIN Fold A numbers h_SLU 1.2485 / h_intent 0.9943 are recorded in this package as CONTEXT ONLY and are explicitly NOT this cell's bar: they were measured on a different roster, against a different gold split (TRAIN gold versus devel gold), with a different scorer sibling (slurp-slu-official-train versus slurp-slu-official) and a different clustering (whole speaker versus utterance id). The ORDER is part of the registration: the own-null read SAEA-SLURP-NATIVE-DEFAULT-PLAN-DEV2000-ADDED-OWN-NULL-V1 is completed and its margin table sealed BEFORE the arm's contrast stage is read, and the margins are never adjusted after the arm's numbers are seen.

planner_action_illegal: the flight's own count and the sample ids that carry it, reported whether or not it is zero.

failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. No automatic restart, replay, row filtering, roster, role-graph, prompt, knowledge, geometry or cap change. AT MOST ONE root-diagnosed recovery re-registration for this run, which needs BOTH a new generation attempt id AND a new native_contact_fit.attempt_id (the CELL-1 lesson: the fit gate binds the baseline fit identity and refuses one that already carries evidence); a second failure closes this flight and the fix is proven on a four-row dry run before another mechanism is admitted. RESUME-RECOVERY CLAUSE (owner decision 22 of 2026-09-18): if the abort is an INFRASTRUCTURE failure with code and request bytes unchanged, the one recovery takes the resume-recovery form of harness item E10 -- the same run id, a fresh attempt id, a resume_from declaration naming the predecessor attempt and its trace SHA-256, every COMPLETE row kept without selection under invariant I7r, every partial or unstarted row re-flown in full, no change to the question, roster, comparator, decision rule or caps, and the run-cumulative budget re-checked; otherwise the one recovery is a full re-fly. A partial manifest is never scored and never read.

Iteration 3 changes neither the store nor the selection but the APPLICATION: the Perception unconditional route CELL-2 carried is REMOVED, and the Solver (cap 8), Reviewer (cap 4) and Planner (cap 4) candidate-bound routes each declare scenario_gate majority-candidate-scenario-not-in-v1 over general, alarm, music, social, iot, play and news, so a row whose projected Perception candidates have a majority scenario in that set takes no supply step at that node at all. THE VENUE IS THE POINT: the gated set was chosen on TRAIN Fold A from the CELL-2 read and the general-scenario diagnostic, and it is read here on a roster the Stage-3 line has never touched -- decision 99 replicate venue -- which makes this the FIRST out-of-fold read of the Stage-3 delta line. Comparator: the sealed SAEA-SLURP-NATIVE-DEFAULT-PLAN-DEV2000-ADDED-V1 (official 65.40 / 76.6, flight commit 54f569c6), never re-flown, at the roster OWN null measured by cell PLANr-DEV2000 in this same package. PRIMARY DELIVERABLES: (1) the paired official read against that sealed comparator at the roster own null; (2) the gated-row share per node from the delta-consumption read, with the open/closed decision counts the gate itself receipts; (3) the per-node delta-consumption table (item S3-4s) split by gate outcome; (4) the twin contrast, which decides attribution, never admission; (5) the frontier row (decision 75). READ DISCIPLINE: DEV-2000-ADDED is a development roster (owner decisions 28, 86) -- no test claim, no superiority claim, and no paper-scale or generalisation statement is read from this cell.
quality_gate: no task-quality read before the complete sealed manifest, the exact ordered 1,000 outputs, the native phase summary and the single successful complete official devel score all exist, and not before the registered STOP condition passes (the sealed DEV-2000-ADDED PLAN aggregate reproduces from its own per-sample scores to 1e-6 and the roster identity reproduces). THE OWN NULL IS READ FIRST: the arm's contrast stage is not read until SAEA-SLURP-NATIVE-DEFAULT-PLAN-DEV2000-ADDED-OWN-NULL-V1 has sealed its margin table. The twin is read only after the arm has sealed and been read. The efficiency, gate and delta-consumption reads may proceed from the sealed receipts, trace and server log as soon as the manifest seals, because they touch no answer, reference or quality field.

why_these_seven.chosen_from: docs/results/2026-09-24-slurp-stage3-delta-cell-r02-verdict.md section 4, the CELL-2 per-scenario pooled SLU table on TRAIN Fold A, and docs/results/2026-09-24-slurp-general-scenario-diagnostic.md
why_these_seven.chosen_on: TRAIN Fold A (1,080 rows, 18 scenarios of 60)
why_these_seven.content_where_there_is_reach: CELL-2 arm minus twin, TRAIN Fold A: news +7.4, alarm +4.2, qa +4.2, weather +4.1 pp SLU -- the store pays where it has reach, which is why iteration 3 narrows application rather than changing the store.
why_these_seven.form_not_content: docs/results/2026-09-24-slurp-general-scenario-diagnostic.md: on the 60 general rows the derangement twin loses MORE than the arm (intent -11.67 pp twin versus -6.67 CELL-2 and -10.00 CELL-1), and 0 of the 200 v2 values declare a general target, so the loss is a FORM cost of carrying a supply, not the content of any delta.
why_these_seven.recoverable_amount: small and stated up front: 10.00 pp intent and 11.16 pp pooled SLU-F1 on the 60 general rows, i.e. 0.56 pp intent and 0.24 pp SLU at Fold A grain. The mechanism must cost nothing where it does not fire, which is why an open gate is byte-identical to the ungated route.
why_these_seven.rule_as_applied: the seven strata on which CELL-2's arm lost pooled SLU-F1 against the sealed PLAN arm on TRAIN Fold A. qa (-0.893) and lists (-0.288) also lost and are NOT gated: the seven are the set the general-scenario diagnostic named, and this registration reproduces that set rather than re-deriving a threshold. That the set is a judgement made on one roster, and is read here on another, is the whole point of the venue and is stated in the preregistration as a limitation, not hidden.

the_venue.authority: owner decision 99's replicate venue and owner decisions 102-107; the replicate-on-a-fresh-roster rule CELL-2's own verdict names as the precondition of any effectiveness claim.
the_venue.claim: THE FIRST OUT-OF-FOLD READ OF THE STAGE-3 DELTA LINE. CELL-1, CELL-2 and CELL-1-GEPA were all read on TRAIN Fold A, the roster whose own read chose what the store retains and which strata this gate names. DEV-2000-ADDED is a roster the delta line has never touched.
the_venue.what_that_buys: the gated set is exposed, for the first time, to rows it did not shape. A gain here is a different kind of evidence from a gain on Fold A, and this package says so before contact.
the_venue.what_that_does_not_buy: it is still a DEVELOPMENT roster (owner decisions 28, 86). No test claim, no superiority claim, no generalisation claim. Owner decision 29 allows one test read and it is not this one.
